name: Southeast Asian
description: Instruments of Vietnam, Indonesia, Laos and Thailand: the đàn tranh zither, angklung, khaen and Thai gongs.
credit: Sounds put together for HO[LO] (CC0): HO[LO] Desk's built-in synths and effects, and the Versilian Community Sample Library by Versilian Studios (CC0), angklung and khaen by Berklee College of Music students for the One Laptop per Child sound library (CC BY 3.0), the University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples (free to use without restriction). Each pack keeps its own licence and credit.

source.note: No audio of its own: its sounds play the packs it requires and HO[LO] Desk’s built-in synths.

sounds.name: Đàn Tranh
sounds.note: The Vietnamese zither: bright plucks with bent, sliding notes.

sounds.name: Đàn Tranh Tremolo
sounds.note: Đàn tranh notes played as a fast tremolo.

sounds.name: Angklung
sounds.note: Sundanese bamboo tubes shaken in a frame: a soft, rattling tone.

sounds.name: Khaen
sounds.note: The Lao bamboo mouth organ, chords over a drone.
